name: College of Eloquence
summary: Masters of oratory whose words always land.

features.name: Silver Tongue
features.short: Treat rolls below 10 as 10 on Persuasion and Deception.
features.summary: When you make a Charisma (Persuasion) or Charisma (Deception) check, you can treat a d20 roll of 9 or lower as a 10.

features.name: Unsettling Words
features.short: Bonus action: subtract an inspiration die from a target's next save.
features.summary: As a bonus action, expend a Bardic Inspiration and choose a creature within 60 ft. Roll the die; the creature subtracts it from the next saving throw it makes before the start of your next turn.

features.name: Unfailing Inspiration
features.short: Inspiration isn't lost when the roll still fails.
features.summary: When a creature adds one of your Bardic Inspiration dice to a roll and the roll fails, it keeps the die.

features.name: Universal Speech
features.short: Let creatures understand you whatever language they speak.
features.summary: As an action, choose up to CHA-modifier creatures within 60 ft.: for 1 hour they can understand you regardless of language. Once per long rest (or by spending a spell slot).

features.name: Infectious Inspiration
features.short: When inspiration succeeds, give a free die to someone else.
features.summary: When a creature within 60 ft. succeeds on a roll using your Bardic Inspiration, you can use your reaction to give another creature a Bardic Inspiration die without expending one. Uses: CHA modifier per long rest.
